_description: Maps every major claim in tool_paper.tex to its proof artifact, experimental data, or literature reference. Each entry links a paper claim to the code, data, or theorem that grounds it.

claims.claim: Z3 confirms equilibrium existence in 60/60 claims across 59 certified cells
claims.verification: Sum tier3_verified across all 15 models = 60; sum tier3_total = 60

claims.claim: Z3 confirms stability in 34/60 via Routh-Hurwitz encoding
claims.verification: Sum tier2_verified = 34; sum tier2_total = 60

claims.claim: 96.3% stability classification rate (26/27 equilibria)
claims.verification: Run stability classifier on all 15 models at depth 3. Only lotka_volterra (0/1) unclassified.

claims.claim: Previous Gershgorin-only approach classified 62.5% (10/16)
claims.verification: Historical measurement: before stability.py rewrite, 10/16 equilibria at center boxes classified. 6 returned 'degenerate' (brusselator, goodwin, lotka_volterra, fitzhugh_nagumo, circadian_clock, mutual_activation_switch).

claims.claim: Contraction factors ρ̄ ∈ [0.00, 0.91]
claims.verification: min(mean_contraction) = 0.0 (van_der_pol), max = 0.910 (mapk_cascade)

claims.claim: Newton-guided search achieves 87–1666× speedup on 3-state models
claims.verification: Goodwin: 166.6s bisection / 0.1s newton = 1666×. Repressilator: 69.8s / 0.8s = 87×.

claims.claim: 81–100% coverage with gaps only at bifurcation boundaries
claims.verification: min coverage = 0.812 (fitzhugh_nagumo). All gaps at known bifurcation curves.

claims.claim: 15 biological models spanning polynomial, Hill-function, and rational kinetics
claims.verification: list_benchmarks() returns 15 models. Types: poly (8), hill (6), rational (1).

claims.claim: 4 numerical classification errors caught on Lotka-Volterra
claims.verification: Pseudo-arclength continuation misclassifies 4 equilibria near conservative center.

claims.claim: Borell-TIS kernel verification applicable on all 15 models
claims.verification: Matérn-5/2 has ν=2.5 > d/2 for d ≤ 4. All models satisfy continuity, centred, compact domain.

claims.claim: Composed δ-error ranges from 0.02 (Sel'kov) to 0.38 (Lotka-Volterra)
claims.verification: selkov: 0.0498, lotka_volterra: 0.381

claims.claim: MiniCheck is 1,000 LoC trusted computing base
claims.verification: wc -l phase_cartographer/minicheck.py reports ~1188 lines including comments and blanks

claims.claim: Brusselator coverage reaches 84.4% at depth 5
claims.verification: Depth 5 entry shows coverage_fraction ≈ 0.844

claims.claim: Routh-Hurwitz algebraic check avoids eigenvalue computation for n ≤ 3
claims.verification: For n=2: checks tr(J) < 0 and det(J) > 0. For n=3: checks p > 0, r > 0, pq-r > 0.

claims.claim: Bauer-Fike bound uses eigenvector condition number κ(V)
claims.verification: Computes V from eigenvectors of midpoint Jacobian, κ(V) = ‖V‖₂·‖V⁻¹‖₂, perturbation = κ(V)·ε₂

claims.claim: ~19,000 lines of Python with 209 passing tests
claims.verification: find . -name '*.py' | xargs wc -l; python3 -m pytest tests/ -q

claims.claim: GP calibration: ECE and NLPD metrics
claims.verification: GP calibration study run on all 15 models

claims.claim: Krawczyk theorem: K(X) ⊆ X implies unique zero in X
claims.verification: Standard result from interval analysis. Implementation in phase_cartographer/equilibrium/krawczyk.py

claims.claim: δ-soundness bound: δ_solver < γ / (‖R‖·L_Df·rad + 1)
claims.verification: Implementation computes L_Df, γ, ‖R‖, rad and checks condition

claims.claim: Certificate composition: disjoint cells compose soundly
claims.verification: verify_atlas_composition() checks disjointness and individual cell soundness
